query_text: What reefer air temperature should be used for mature green apples on a long voyage?
answer_text: Set the reefer air temperature to 0°C. The passage also states not to use a setpoint below -1°C.
handbook_passage: For long-voyage carriage of mature green apples, set the reefer air temperature to 0°C. Do not use a setpoint below -1°C.
source_reference: Refrigerated Cargo Handling Manual, Section 4.2, p. 37
